compiled_state.title: [dso:code-reviewer-*]: write reviewer-findings.json -> REVIEWER_HASH field included in JSON body causes record-review.sh hash mismatch
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 1e0637b55b70c0373d29e689949d785789395336
* **Context Scope:** worktree-20260430-212540, commit workflow for task fe61-6f2a

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and record-review.sh, the review agent writes reviewer-findings.json to the artifacts directory WITHOUT a REVIEWER_HASH field in the JSON body. The agent then computes sha256 of the file and reports `REVIEWER_HASH=<hash>` in its stdout only. record-review.sh then verifies: `shasum -a 256 reviewer-findings.json` matches the `--reviewer-hash` argument passed to it.

#### Actual Behavior

When prompted (via a custom orchestrator prompt) to write reviewer-findings.json and output a REVIEWER_HASH, the dso:code-reviewer-standard agent wrote the REVIEWER_HASH value as a field inside the JSON body:

```json
{
  "summary": { ... },
  "findings": [ ... ],
  "REVIEWER_HASH": "5976c13eabd2dd41fd8446c49f6010d1bb1a30c9c1b5049110bdd86983dabb19"
}
```

The agent reported `REVIEWER_HASH=5976c13...` which was the sha256 computed BEFORE the REVIEWER_HASH field was added to the JSON. After the field was added, the actual file sha256 changed to a different value.

record-review.sh then failed:
```
ERROR: reviewer-findings.json hash mismatch — file was tampered with
  Expected: 5976c13eabd2...
  Actual:   4f795d15181c...
```

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* **Steps Taken:**
  * Dispatched dso:code-reviewer-standard with prompt requesting it write reviewer-findings.json and output REVIEWER_HASH
  * Agent reported REVIEWER_HASH=5976c13...
  * Ran record-review.sh --reviewer-hash 5976c13...
  * Observed hash mismatch error
  * Manually removed REVIEWER_HASH field from JSON — but sha256 still didn't match the reported hash because formatting differed
* **Known Workarounds:** Dispatch review agent via /dso:review Skill tool (not inline Agent dispatch) which properly handles artifacts directory path and hash reporting.

comments.body: Classification: llm-behavioral — ticket references agent behavior (reviewer writing REVIEWER_HASH in JSON body); affected files are code-reviewer-*.md in agents/ directory. Dispatching bot-psychologist.

comments.body: Classification: llm-behavioral. Root cause: reviewer-base.md prohibited-key list omitted REVIEWER_HASH and didn't explain that write-reviewer-findings.sh mutates the file. Fix: bot-psychologist added REVIEWER_HASH to prohibited list and added causal explanation. Applied to reviewer-base.md + all 10 compiled agent files.
